details: Anthropic has introduced a self-hosted Claude apps gateway for enterprises running Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock or Google Cloud. The gateway acts as an OpenID Connect relying party, federating sign-in through existing IdPs.

caption:
What if your coding agent's secrets were stolen? Anthropic's new OIDC gateway aims to fix that.

Anthropic has introduced a self-hosted Claude apps gateway for enterprises running Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock or Google Cloud. The gateway acts as an OpenID Connect relying party, federating sign-in through existing IdPs.

The gateway replaces long-lived per-developer secrets with short-lived OIDC sessions, centralizing identity, policy enforcement, usage tracking, and spend management for Claude Code.

This change allows for easier revocation of access and reduces the blast radius of a compromised Claude Code install on a developer laptop.
